definition: Today's documented research behind Transparent Aluminum Panels.

The Materials Genome Initiative accelerates computational discovery of new materials. Together these programs form the ALON plates foundation that Transparent Aluminum Panels will build on — the panel logistics results, the sintering tech methods, and the institutional memory.

Forecasts are projections, not promises: the dated milestones in this database reflect published roadmaps and expert surveys, and they will move as panel logistics research advances. Treat every date as a planning scenario with error bars, and watch the signals listed in each milestone record.

title: Transparent Aluminum Panels Master Roadmap
definition: The united roadmap for Transparent Aluminum Panels: prove, build, operate, compound.
description:
The master roadmap for Transparent Aluminum Panels — aluminum oxynitride windows for extreme use.

Phase 1 — Prove (ALON plates): laboratory demonstrations of every component, replicated independently. No scaling until the physics is boring.

Phase 2 — Build (panel logistics): pilot manufacturing and integration. The six pieces meet for the first time and the interfaces get honest.

Phase 3 — Operate (sintering tech): continuous real-world operation. Uptime, cost curves and failure data replace projections.

Phase 4 — Compound (ballistic ratings): panel hulls as everyday infrastructure. Costs collapse, standards settle, and aerospace-scale deployment begins.

Public edition: phases follow documented research readiness. This record unites the database: overview, research, components, milestones, demos and drills all point here.
